chunks: Ali narrated from his father, and Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, both from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:
I saw Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام offering condolences before the burial and after it.

key_terms.بَعْدَهُ: after it, meaning after the burial
key_terms.رَأَيْتُ: I saw; a direct eyewitness report by the narrator
key_terms.مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام
key_terms.يُعَزِّي: he was offering condolences to the bereaved

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to offer condolences before burial as well as after burial in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام offered condolences both before the burial and after it. It indicates the permissibility and established practice of ta'ziyah at both times in connection with death and burial.
